Thanks to the patented Radiation Error Correction System, MeteoTracker measurements are very accurate even under strong solar exposure and its very high measurement speed allows to catch even the sharpest temperature variation encountered on the move (up to 15° C over a few hundred meters).
MeteoTracker magnetic base and its compact dimensions (~ 70 mm x 70 mm x 35 mm) allow full portability and ease of installation.
